character.name: Exusiai the New Covenant
character.itemUsage: Veteran employee of Penguin Logistics and boss of Apple Pie Logistics, Exusiai, only just back at Rhodes Island from Laterano.
character.itemDesc: She gave herself a Best Boss medal, determined to bring business and glad tidings to every corner of this land.
